sentence: This project studies how to protect sensitive scientific data on clouds while servers answer queries on the encrypted data.
This project builds terahertz filters that can be tuned using optical control signals instead of electrical control wires.
This project builds models and algorithms to analyze temporal networks, with uses in intrusion detection and anti-money laundering.
This project supports a workshop on combinatorial algorithms, which study objects such as strings and graphs.
This project builds a platform that makes hyperpolarized biomolecules in a continuous flow, to give spectroscopy and imaging enhanced sensitivity.
This project builds a neural network to predict intrinsic disorder in proteins, including those of bacterial and archaeal organisms.
This project studies gene expression in individual cells of the developing maize shoot to understand how shoot meristems form and make organs.
This project uses the fossil record and modern mammals to study how animal traits relate to environments and how animals respond to environmental change.
This project studies ultrathin sheets of metals covered by graphene and crystalline materials made of many chemical elements.
This project builds a system to observe children with autism doing a brief video game-like motor imitation task and assess their imitation.
This project uses ancient DNA from calcified dental plaque to trace how the human oral microbiome changed with diet and environment.
This project develops theory to explain how robust neural networks are against adversarial examples, and how adversarial training works.
This project tries to find out under what conditions an AI-enabled autonomous system can be trusted to operate safely.
This project builds a compilation system that maps deep neural network models onto tensorized instructions to improve efficiency.
This project builds statistical tools that use mobility data to detect an epidemic outbreak early and identify infected individuals.
This project studies how evolutionary responses of a plant to elevated carbon dioxide and nitrogen enrichment affect carbon storage in coastal marsh ecosystems.
